title: Turla operating through acquired OilRig tooling and infrastructure (2017-2019) - documented piggy-back
ground_truth_basis: UK NCSC / US NSA joint advisory 'Turla group exploits Iranian APT to expand coverage of victims' (21 Oct 2019): Neuron/Nautilus are Iranian-origin tools acquired and deployed by Turla, which also accessed OilRig infrastructure; Symantec 'Waterbug' report (20 Jun 2019).

kg_additions.name: Neuron / Nautilus implants - Iranian-origin tooling (per NCSC/NSA 2019)
kg_additions.source: NCSC/NSA advisory 'Turla group exploits Iranian APT to expand coverage of victims' (21 Oct 2019)

kg_additions.name: OilRig (Crambus) command-and-control infrastructure later accessed by Turla
kg_additions.source: Symantec 'Waterbug: Espionage Group Rolls Out Brand-New Toolset in Attacks Against Governments' (20 Jun 2019)

notes: Tooling and infrastructure point to OilRig (Iran); the co-resident Snake/Uroburos implant and its tradecraft point to Turla (Russia). The infrastructure token stands in for the Crambus C2 servers named by Symantec; values are not reproduced.
